title: Supreme Court: Court operations suspended in some areas on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026
summary: The Supreme Court has announced that court operations in some areas are suspended on Monday, November 16, 2026.

blocks.text: The Supreme Court has announced that court operations in some areas are suspended on Monday, November 16, 2026.
The affected areas are the following:

items: Supreme Court and Offices of the Regional Court Managers in NCR-A and NCR-B - 49th ASEAN Summit and related events
Court of Appeals - Manila - 49th ASEAN Summit and related events
Sandiganbayan - 49th ASEAN Summit and related events
Court of Tax Appeals - 49th ASEAN Summit and related events
All courts within the National Capital Judicial Region - 49th ASEAN Summit and related events
All courts in Occidental Mindoro - 76th Founding Anniversary
All courts in Bansud, Oriental Mindoro - 76th Founding Anniversary

blocks.text: Refresh this page for updates. — BAP, GMA News
